intro: Murloc Gills is an Alliance task in Westfall given by Alba Fairmoon. Amid concerns that the crop blight could poison coastal fisheries, adventurers are dispatched to the Longshore to collect murloc gills for ecological analysis. Because murloc physiology is acutely sensitive to maritime contaminants, their gills reveal whether toxins have infiltrated the sea.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The corruption affecting Westfall's crops may have seeped into the ocean as well. If the local fish are affected too, it could doom Stormwind to famine.

Collect gills from the murlocs along the shoreline and bring them to me. Murlocs are quite hardy, but their physiology is extremely sensitive to contaminants. Any toxins in the seawater will be readily apparent in the gills you find.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I hope the murlocs did not give you too much trouble?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I see... These gills appear to be healthy, for now. But we must not be complacent.
